name: Trader (AI trading agent + dashboard)
install: ([ -d /usr/lib/postgresql ] || (sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib)) && corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm db:generate
start: [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; bash scripts/db-start.sh && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
